Subject: Secure view link + IP allowlist before audit window

Hi Kimberly / Ben,

We're getting the audit kickoff next week and the auditors have trouble with expiring links when they route through our corporate proxy. Can you do two things for the upcoming SOC 2 Type II review?

1) Issue a secure view link for the SOC 2 bundle that will remain valid for 48 hours starting 2028-06-07 13:00 PDT (auditor's scheduled window).
2) Allow a temporary IP exception for the auditor's outbound IPs (file attached with the list) so downloads don't fail when the proxy rewrites headers.

We tried the one-time SSO link earlier and it expired before the auditor completed the download. If you can confirm both items and share the link and any special instructions (MFA, recommended browser, max simultaneous downloads), that would help us avoid delays.

I've attached the auditor IP list and a short request form.

Thanks — Sam
Sam Reynolds
IT Risk Manager | FinTrust Bank
sam.reynolds@fintrust.com

Subject: Re: Secure view link + IP allowlist before audit window

Hi Sam — thanks for the heads up.

We can do both but need a couple of clarifications so we implement this without widening access accidentally:

- Confirm the exact UTC window you want us to enable the 48-hour link. You mentioned 2028-06-07 13:00 PDT — that maps to 2028-06-07 20:00 UTC, correct?
- The IP list you attached looks like a mix of auditor lab IPs and your corporate egress. Please confirm which rows are the auditor gateway IPs that we should allow on our ACL (we should only allow the auditor vendor ranges).

Plan:
- If we get the auditor CIDR ranges today, we can configure a temporary ACL and create an expiring secure view link that starts at the requested time.
- We'll set the link TTL to 48 hours and disable download retries after three attempts. If the auditor needs an extension we can provide a bridge letter and extend for another 24 hours under explicit approval.

I'll hand this to Ben to apply the ACL and generate the link.

Best,
Kimberly Park
Senior Trust & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference

- The 13:00 PDT time is correct (that is 20:00 UTC).
- The attached auditor-ip-list.csv has two sections — rows 1-4 are the auditor vendor (External Audit LLP) public egress IPs; rows 5-6 are our internal egress points — please only whitelist rows 1-4: 203.0.113.12/32, 203.0.113.34/32, 198.51.100.7/32, 198.51.100.8/32.

Also: the auditor will connect from a machine that enforces strict TLS ciphers and blocks cookies in some browsers. If you can add a note to the access instructions recommending Chrome + allow third-party cookies during the download, that would be helpful.

I've attached a short access matrix showing which report PDFs they need to download.

Sam
